Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the critical birthplace information from the search results in the first step. Although the search results clearly displayed "Born R. Krishnamoorthy, August 8, 1951, Theni, Tamil Nadu, India" in the visible viewport (from the Celebrity Borns and Wikipedia snippets), the agent's report did not explicitly state this finding. Instead, it only confirmed the director's name and noted that "exact birthplace details were not definitively confirmed in the visible snippet" in the subsequent Planner analysis. This failure to extract and report the available data forced the system into an unnecessary loop of re-searching and re-verifying information that was already present, delaying the final conclusion.
